mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms; combined use increases risk of hypotension, hyperkalemia, and acute kidney injury due to synergistic effects on renal hemodynamics.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and renal function (creatinine/eGFR) regularly; adjust doses as needed and counsel patients on hypotension symptoms; combination is commonly used but requires baseline and periodic monitoring.
